dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: City walls? Where'd they come from?

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Hmm? Are we not within our defensive walls as we speak?

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Ah, wait, I see... You're testing me! Why, just as Dominus Boethius once said, "the mighty legions are the true walls of the empire"!
